question: Can conformity to actions explain experience without obstructing consciousness by those actions?
premises: Experiences may be attributed to conformity with actions
Actions are proposed as limiting factors
Consciousness itself would not be obstructed by actions
inference: If conformity to actions is the cause, consciousness is not truly obstructed by actions.
plain_english: If it is due to conformity with actions, then there is no obstruction of consciousness by actions.
